newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-PACY FREE STATE BEAT W.P. 25-16.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-PACY FREE STATE BEAT W.P. 25-16.

text.p: Free State, with their back line producing pacy, running rugby, retained second place in group B of the 1996 Currie Cup after a 25-16 victory (halftime 10-6) over Western Province at the Free State stadium on Saturday.
Captain and centre Helgard Muller celebrated his 200th game for the Cheetahs and played a large role in his team's victory as they ran Province off their feet.
But Western Province may well blame their place-kickers as flyhalf Joel Stransky and wing Vlok Cilliers missed six kicks at goal between them.
A try from replacement prop Toks van der Linde came too late to give Province any chance of avenging their defeat against Free State earlier in the season.
An exciting game full of running rugby was, however, marred by continual fighting which came to a head when Free State number eight Jaco Coetzee was sent off late in the second half.
Free State - Tries: Andre Pawson, Jan-Harm van Wyk, Brendan Venter. Conversions: M.J. Smith (2). Penalties: Smith (2).
Western Province - Try: Toks van der Linde. Conversion: Joel Stransky. Penalties: Stransky, Vlok Cilliers (2).
